meta.title: Recreate Order from a live RFQ (while bidding is on)
gaps: Verify that the recreated event is independent from the original live RFQ.
Verify that the original live RFQ continues running after recreation.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the recreated event is independent from the original live RFQ.; Verify that the original live RFQ continues running after recreation.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ as the buyer; prepared-state rules require this as the first step.
Open the current RFQ stage Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Verify that the recreation dialog exposes the Create Order action with defaults.
Confirm the recreation flow completed without an application error.
